title: Let claim --next skip busy tasks
body:
`claimNext` aborts the whole command when one ready task is busy (`src/task/claims.ts:235`), so concurrent `claim --next` callers get exit 75 while other ready tasks are free (busy=4 in 17 trials at load 27–46, review N2).
Acceptance: with N callers and at least N ready tasks every caller claims a distinct task; exit 75 only when no ready task can be claimed.
